research_notes: The eventual final contract should be short enough to inject into workers without consuming excessive context.
Raw research rationale can remain in durable documents while runtime workers receive only target/cutoff/reserve/admission/rollback essentials.
This reduces context overhead and aligns with the user's preference for minimal operational rules.
The present research can be verbose because it is producing evidence, but deployment should not be.
A validated policy should therefore include both detailed evidence and a compact execution form.
Current Phase A contributes to the evidence layer.
